name: Weighted Dice
commentary:
If your shop has a piece on your board or bench, and you don't purchase it and instead choose to reroll, your re-roll will return 1-2 gold i.e. it will be either free or half price.

Very useful for rolling boards where you might prioritise certain units early.

source.name: Weighted Dice
source.description: Refund 1~2 random Gold if you fail to recruit any owned chess piece.

descriptions.en: Refund 1~2 random Gold if you fail to recruit any owned chess piece.
